analysis:
PORTFOLIO REVIEW: All four positions (AMP, BR, MCO, NVDA) are marginally underwater (-0.65% to -1.77%) but none show thesis breaks. These are quality businesses at fair prices that passed both fundamental and technical filters. Losses are within normal noise; no forced exits warranted. However, the historical performance demands honest acknowledgment — 10% win rate and 0.03x profit factor indicates the execution has been poor. The mandate here is to be disciplined, not to manufacture activity.

MARKET REGIME: MIXED (-0.7% vs SMA50 but rising 20d slope). Not a confirmed bull phase. This calls for high selectivity on new entries and smaller position additions.

NEW TRADE RATIONALE: With 4 open positions and $30,964 headroom, capacity exists for one more name to reach the 5-position maximum. The sole candidate meeting all criteria — basing in the lower half of the 52w range, confirmed uptrend, quality fundamentals, sufficient earnings runway — is ULTA. Most other high-quality names (ANET, NTAP, CPAY, CRM, TRV, A) are extended (>85% of 52w range and/or >15% above SMA50), violating entry timing rules. ACN has earnings in 14 days — too risky to enter. CMG and DG are MIXED/SIDEWAYS (not confirmed uptrends). Given the track record, only one high-conviction trade is proposed; cash is the remainder. Preserving capital and waiting for clearer setups is the right posture.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $528-532 (near current market price). Prefer a 1-2 day mild pullback to $525-528 to improve entry. Do not chase above $535.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: Ulta Beauty is a high-quality specialty retailer with exceptional economics — ROE of 46.1%, FCF of $914M, and operating cash flow of $1.6B. Fwd P/E of 16.5x is reasonable for this quality level, with 8.9% revenue growth and a dominant loyalty ecosystem (44M+ members) providing durable competitive advantage. Minimal EPS revision drag (+0.4%) but no deterioration. TECHNICAL: Price at 31% of 52w range, basing above key support with SMA50 slope rising at +6.1%. Just +2.6% above SMA50 — confirmed uptrend without being extended. ATR of 3.5% produces a 2x ATR stop at $492, placing the stop 7.2% below entry — within the 4-15% valid zone. Earnings not until Dec 3 (77 days), giving a clean holding window. Position sizing: 38 shares * $530 = $20,140 (21.2% of equity, within 25% cap); worst-case loss = 38 * $38 = $1,444 = 1.52% of equity.
trades.exit_plan: Exit if: (1) price closes below $492 stop; (2) thesis break — same-store sales growth turns negative or loyalty program metrics deteriorate materially in Dec 3 earnings; (3) stock rallies into the $635-650 zone and shows distribution/reversal signs ahead of target; (4) time stop — if price has not made progress toward target within 10 weeks of entry, reassess and exit regardless of price level; (5) market regime shifts to confirmed downtrend (SPY below SMA200).
